name: resolve_environment

test_list.description: A trusted host annotation for the exact canonical repository and full commit wins without invoking the ranker when requested runtime, architecture, language, and toolchain constraints also match.
An exact repository and commit image is excluded when a requested runtime or architecture constraint does not match.
An exact repository and commit image is excluded when its declared toolchain version differs from the manifest requirement.
A unique image whose trusted language and exact toolchain metadata satisfy a nonempty manifest requirement is selected deterministically.
Multiple exact candidates are passed in stable image-id order to the injected ranker, whose unique highest valid score selects the image.
An external ranker can inspect manifest constraints, trusted annotations, and actual upstream ImageRecord fields through typed getters and use a real record tag to rank eligible candidates.
Equal highest ranker scores remain an explicit ambiguity rather than being selected by input or sort order.
Manifest construction rejects repository URLs and abbreviated Git object IDs.
The ranker must score every candidate exactly once; an omitted candidate produces a typed invalid-ranker-output error.
Duplicate score IDs and IDs absent from actual list_images records are rejected.
A score outside the integer basis-point range 0 through 10000 is rejected.
Duplicate upstream image IDs or duplicate trusted host annotation IDs fail closed.
Trusted metadata cannot introduce an image identity that was absent from the actual list_images result.
No compatible candidate and arbitrary metadata without a repo match or positive compatibility requirement both return a typed no-match error.
Permuting equivalent image and annotation input order does not change the stable ranked result.
Catalog and annotation input counts above configured bounds are rejected before ranking.

inputs.name: manifest
inputs.description: Validated repository, full Git object ID, and declared runtime/language/toolchain/architecture requirements.

inputs.name: images
inputs.description: Actual image identities returned by the Contree list_images API; upstream records are not extended with guessed fields.

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.description: Explicit host-trusted annotations keyed by actual ImageId values.

inputs.name: ranker
inputs.description: Injected ambiguity resolver, called only with a bounded stable candidate set.

output_description: The selected actual Contree image ID and match reason, or a typed error for invalid inputs, no match, or invalid/ambiguous ranker output.
